description: This is a base class for CoAP adapter integration tests in a Java project, providing common setup, utility methods, and test helpers for testing CoAP services using the Eclipse Hono framework.

classes.name: CoapTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common setup, utility methods, and test infrastructure for CoAP protocol integration testing within the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: getCoapClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new CoAP client for unsecured communication.

methods.name: getCoapsClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new CoAP client configured for secure DTLS communication with a pre-shared key store.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns a CoapHandler that invokes a specified response handler based on the response's outcome, expecting a particular response code.

methods.name: createCoapRequest
methods.description: Constructs a CoAP Request with specified method, message type, resource path, and message number.

methods.name: createCoapsRequest
methods.description: Constructs a secure CoAP Request with specified method, message type, resource path, and message number.

methods.name: getCoapRequestUri
methods.description: Returns the URI for a given resource path using the 'coap' scheme.

methods.name: getCoapsRequestUri
methods.description: Returns the URI for a given resource path using the 'coaps' scheme.

methods.name: assertMessageProperties
methods.description: Performs assertions on message properties to verify correctness of received messages.

methods.name: assertAdditionalMessageProperties
methods.description: Placeholder for subclasses to implement additional message property assertions.

methods.name: assertCoapResponse
methods.description: Default implementation for verifying CoAP responses; subclasses may override.

methods.name: sendWarmUpMessages
methods.description: Method to send warm-up messages; default implementation does nothing, can be overridden.
